rulings.restated: Choose — [helper "Number of qualifying children for the EIC who have valid SSNs" ≥ 0 (a count) and helper "Number of qualifying children for the EIC who have valid SSNs" < 1 (a count) → helper "EIC Table credit for line 3, no qualifying children with valid SSNs"] [helper "Number of qualifying children for the EIC who have valid SSNs" ≥ 1 (a count) and helper "Number of qualifying children for the EIC who have valid SSNs" < 2 (a count) → helper "EIC Table credit for line 3, one qualifying child with a valid SSN"] [helper "Number of qualifying children for the EIC who have valid SSNs" ≥ 2 (a count) and helper "Number of qualifying children for the EIC who have valid SSNs" < 3 (a count) → helper "EIC Table credit for line 3, two qualifying children with valid SSNs"] [helper "Number of qualifying children for the EIC who have valid SSNs" ≥ 3 (a count) → helper "EIC Table credit for line 3, three or more qualifying children with valid SSNs"]
rulings.model: The restatement always fills line 5 with the table credit for line 3. The IRS says 'Yes. Skip line 5' at line 4 and 'Yes. Leave line 5 blank' when line 3 is under the threshold, so the printed line should be blank in those cases. The lookup itself and line 6 are correct.
rulings.ruling: Ruling: representation; project retained. The project figures line 5 always and line 6 reads it only when line 4 is No and line 3 is not less than the line 5 amount (eic.after_line4, eic.line6), so the skip and the blank of the printed line are kept in effect; line 6 and the credit are unaffected.
